description: Maya owns a home DNA-testing kit that the family bought to learn more about their ancestry. She must decide whether to mail it and finalize the privacy, sample-destruction, and results-sharing settings after hearing from the other three family members.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: DNA Kit Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family has one home DNA-testing kit with four saliva tubes, and everyone has been curious about their ancestry.
shared_context.S2: Maya has the kit and will make the final decision about whether it is mailed and how the account is configured.
shared_context.S3: The provider's account offers choices about law-enforcement matching, biological-sample retention, and sharing ancestry results.
shared_context.S4: Before Maya mails the kit, the family's usual check-in is for each person involved to say anything that should shape the decision.
shared_context.S5: The kit's activation instructions require an activation date to be entered when the package is registered.

PF1.text: Noah will provide his sample only if law-enforcement matching is turned off and the biological sample is destroyed after the results are issued.

PF2.text: Priya read the current terms in the kit insert, which say the kit must be activated by June 30, 2027, and that raw biological data can be destroyed only by requesting destruction within 30 days after results arrive; she has not shared this with the group.

PF3.text: Lena has a note from their late grandmother asking that any family ancestry results be shared only with named relatives and never posted publicly; the note has not reached the group.

acceptance_conditions: The kit must be mailed for the family ancestry test.
Law-enforcement matching must be turned off.
The raw biological data destruction request must be scheduled within 30 days after results arrive.
Results must be shared only with named relatives.
The kit must be activated by June 30, 2027.
A commitment to request destruction of the raw biological data within 30 days after results arrive must be recorded.
A commitment to keep results within the named-family group must be recorded.

content_checks.C3: decisions['sample_retention_plan'] in ['request_destruction_within_30_days_of_results', 'Request raw biological data destruction within 30 days after results arrive, managed by Maya', 'Request sample destruction within 30 days after results arrive', 'Request destruction of raw biological data within 30 days after results arrive, per the provider\'s terms.', 'Select sample destruction option, and someone will actively request destruction of raw biological data within 30 days after results arrive, per the kit\'s terms.']
content_checks.C4: decisions['results_sharing'] in ['named_relatives_only', 'Named relatives only, never public, honoring late grandmother\'s wishes', 'Named relatives only, no public posting', 'Share ancestry results only with named relatives; no public posting of any results.', 'Share ancestry results only with named relatives; never post publicly, per grandmother\'s note.']
content_checks.C5: decisions['activation_deadline'] in ['2027-06-30', 'Activate before June 30, 2027', 'Enter an activation date before June 30, 2027 when registering the package.', 'Must activate by June 30, 2027.', 'Activate before June 30, 2027.']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['sample_destruction', 'action', 'configure_setting', 'configuration_commitment'] and c['detail'] in ['Maya will submit the raw biological data destruction request within 30 days after results arrive', 'Sample destruction will be requested within 30 days after results arrive', 'I will request destruction of raw biological data within 30 days after results arrive, as described in the kit insert terms.', 'Sample destruction will be selected, and I will ensure someone actively requests destruction of raw biological data within 30 days after results arrive, as required by the kit\'s terms.'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['results_sharing', 'setting', 'configure_setting', 'configuration_commitment'] and c['detail'] in ['Results sharing set to named relatives only, never public, to honor late grandmother\'s note', 'Sharing will be limited to named relatives only, no public posting, honoring grandmother\'s wishes', 'Ancestry results will be shared only with named relatives and never posted publicly, honoring grandmother\'s note.', 'Ancestry results will be shared only with named relatives and never posted publicly, honoring our late grandmother\'s note.'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Noah's participation requires law-enforcement matching to be set to false and requires a concrete raw-data destruction commitment rather than leaving the provider's default settings in place.
Priya's terms specify the exact 30-day destruction-request window and the exact June 30, 2027 activation deadline.
The grandmother's note changes results sharing to named relatives only, requires no public posting, and supplies the specific family preference that must be cited.
